items.title: Lithium hydroxide futures debut: weak fundamental support, bearish outlook
items.summary: Fengneng Futures said in a Nov. 26 report that lithium hydroxide futures began trading on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange with a benchmark price of 75,000 yuan/metric ton. The contract opened lower and extended losses, with the LI2706 lead contract trading between 69,140 and 73,180 yuan before settling at 69,600 yuan, down 7.20%. Volume was 74,300 lots and open interest 9,830 lots, with liquidity concentrated in the lead contract. Expectations of Fed rate hikes weighed on liquidity and risk appetite, while equities and commodities broadly retreated. Lithium hydroxide fundamentals are weaker than those for lithium carbonate: downstream production schedules are softening, the supply chain is destocking, and the market is entering a seasonal lull. Mine supply is easing, with additional output expected from the resumption of Jiangxi lithium mines. Unless supply is materially disrupted, the market is expected to shift to inventory builds in Q1 2027. With supply and demand broadly loose and little fundamental price support, the report favored selling rallies.

SpaceX要求逐周核算GPU用途，1万张外租月度合同额约8400万美元
items.summary: 马斯克今年8月将SpaceX AI团队数百名工程师的群聊改名为“Sell compute because we can't compete”（卖算力，因为我们竞争不过），要求工程师每周汇报GPU用途，并强调竞争力的核心指标是“每张GPU带来的收入”，而非模型基准测试。SpaceX正同时向外出租算力并发展自有Grok等AI业务：Anthropic已获得Colossus 1全部算力，涉及超过22万张英伟达GPU；其招股书披露，与SpaceXAI签订的多份算力协议全部交付后，合计月付款约31亿美元。Google则以每月9.2亿美元租用约11万张GPU及配套基础设施，按GPU数量线性折算，每1万张对应约8360万美元月度合同额。SpaceX第三季度超级智能（SI）业务收入75.6亿美元，资本开支164.44亿美元。马斯克10月在财报电话会上表示，目标是将算力大致各半分配给内部业务和外部客户，并根据需求动态调整。算力因此成为SpaceX需要在外租现金收入与自研模型潜在回报之间持续权衡的核心资产。

items.title: China develops first metal-powder-fueled afterburning turbojet prototype, completes ground ignition test
items.summary: A team led by Sun Haijun at Nanchang Hangkong University has independently developed China’s first metal-powder-fueled afterburning turbojet prototype and completed a ground ignition test, with support from a Jiangxi provincial R&D program. The test was the first of its kind globally and validated the feasibility of the propulsion concept, marking a step forward for China’s metal-powder-fueled aero-turbine technology.

items.title: Musk Advises Continuing to Hold SpaceX Shares
items.summary: Musk said SpaceX could be worth about 1 million times the current global economy if it makes humanity a multiplanetary species and harnesses even one-millionth of the Sun’s energy, adding that he recommends holding the shares despite the goals’ extraordinary difficulty. He previously said every U.S. child would receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from him. The company’s shares are due to be transferred next month; Musk’s shares will be transferred next June, after the lockup expires.

items.title: EU fiscal risks mount as Commission warns financial system is nearing a tipping point
items.summary: EU Economy Commissioner Dombrovskis said the EU financial system is nearing a tipping point as high deficits, heavy public debt and rising borrowing costs reinforce one another. The European Commission forecasts the EU's average budget deficit will rise from 3.1% of GDP in 2025 to 3.8% in 2028, with 12 member states exceeding the 3% limit in 2026 and 16 by 2028. Average public debt is projected to increase from 82.6% to 85.6% of GDP over the same period; more than half of member states will exceed the 60% debt threshold this year, including four above 100%. Rising global yields and sovereign risk premiums are pushing up government borrowing costs. The report did not address the impact of higher military spending on fiscal pressures.

items.summary: 【欧盟财政风险持续累积，委员会警告金融体系逼近临界点】金十数据11月26日讯，欧盟经济委员东布罗夫斯基斯指出，由于预算赤字过高、公共债务规模庞大以及借贷成本上升，欧盟金融体系正逼近临界点。他表示，欧盟公共财政状况“并未朝着正确方向发展”，目前已处于“关键时刻”。他指出欧盟公共财政中三个相互强化的负面趋势：第一，欧盟委员会秋季预测显示，欧盟平均财政赤字占GDP比重将从2025年的3.1%升至2028年的3.8%，2026年将有12个成员国赤字率超过3%的上限，到2028年增至16个；第二，欧盟平均公共债务占GDP比重预计同期从82.6%升至85.6%，今年将有超过半数成员国债务率高于60%，其中4国超过100%。第三，全球市场收益率上升及主权债券风险溢价走高，正推高政府借贷成本。不过，报告未提及欧盟军事开支增长对财政压力的影响。

items.title: Inflation concerns persist as gilt yields rise
items.summary: Gilt yields climbed as investors bet persistent inflation could prompt the Bank of England to raise rates sharply in coming months. Brent remains above $90 a barrel, adding to energy inflation risks and the prospect of further rate hikes. LSEG data show markets expect three more BoE hikes by July 2027, after the bank raised rates by 25 bps in November. Tradeweb data show the 10-year gilt yield up 2.5 bps at 5.159%.

The three countries signed a mutual defense agreement in Mecca in August as the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran escalated and regional concerns mounted.

items.title: Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities raises BOJ terminal rate forecast to 2%
items.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities now expects the BOJ to raise rates to 1.50% in December, 1.75% in March 2027 and a terminal rate of 2% in June 2027, versus its previous forecast for a 1.75% peak in April 2027. Strategist Naomi Muguruma said the BOJ may struggle to delay its next move until April if the Federal Reserve delivers back-to-back hikes in December and January. A wider U.S.-Japan rate gap would raise the risk of dollar appreciation and yen depreciation, increasing the chance that underlying inflation exceeds 2%, a scenario the BOJ is wary of.

items.title: MOFCOM official outlines 15th Five-Year Plan for service trade
items.summary: The Plan’s targets place greater emphasis on quality and efficiency. They call for steady growth in service trade and its share of total foreign trade, a more balanced import-export mix, faster digital, intelligent and green development, and knowledge-intensive services to become a key growth driver. The Plan also seeks to improve domestic and regional coordination and diversify international markets; strengthen firms’ innovation and market-expansion capabilities and move them up the value chain; raise China’s standing in global value chains and its influence in international rulemaking; and improve the institutional environment.

items.title: European gas storage withdrawals hit record
items.summary: Daily withdrawals from European underground gas storage hit a record as the first sharp cold snap arrived in late November, consuming more than 15% of summer injections, GIE data show. Since the heating season began on Oct. 28, more than 9 bcm has been withdrawn; cumulative withdrawals are 31% above the five-year average. On Nov. 24, storage was 67.84% full, the lowest level for that date since records began in 2011. EU inventories stood at about 74.3 bcm, down 11.9 bcm year on year and the lowest since 2013. Storage peaked at 74.96% four weeks earlier.

items.summary: 【欧洲地下储气库天然气提取量创纪录】金十数据11月26日讯，根据欧洲天然气基础设施协会（GIE）数据计算，随着11月底首轮明显寒潮来袭，欧洲地下储气库的天然气日提取量再次达到创纪录水平，夏季注入量已被消耗超过15%。欧洲进入供暖季时，天然气库存已处于历史同期低位。地下储气库在秋季达到最高注气水平（74.96%）至今已过去四周，但累计提取量仍比过去五年的平均水平高出31%。自10月28日供暖季开始以来，欧洲已从储气设施中提取超过90亿立方米天然气。截至11月24日，欧洲地下储气库的平均库存水平为67.84%，为自2011年有记录以来同期最低水平。欧盟储气设施目前储存的天然气约为743亿立方米，比去年同期少119亿立方米，也是2013年以来的最低水平。

items.title: SoftBank five-year CDS spread widens for second day
items.summary: The cost of insuring SoftBank debt rose for a second straight day on Thursday as investors grew more concerned that its AI investments may not generate returns quickly enough to cover debt. The five-year CDS spread widened more than 20 bps to 534.6 bps, a four-year high, implying a 34.8% probability of default. SoftBank is seen as a bellwether for AI investment prospects because it owns a stake in OpenAI. Its shares and bonds have come under pressure as investors question whether massive AI infrastructure spending will pay off.

items.title: Belt and Road energy investment and construction cooperation tops 3.33 tln yuan
items.summary: China National Energy Administration head Wang Hongzhi said Belt and Road energy cooperation has expanded over more than a decade. The Central Asia gas pipeline has delivered about 500 bln cubic meters of gas, while 16 cross-border power links of at least 110 kV have been built in the Lancang-Mekong region, enabling more than 80 bln kWh of electricity transfers. Renewable energy capacity in Belt and Road partner countries has exceeded 600 GW, quadrupling in a decade, with China working on green energy projects with more than 100 countries and regions. The Belt and Road Energy Partnership has 35 member countries and nearly 300 Chinese and foreign companies. Cumulative energy investment and construction cooperation under the initiative exceeded 3.33 tln yuan as of end-2025, according to research institutions.

items.title: Guangdong to back token trading zones at Guangzhou, Shenzhen data exchanges
items.summary: Guangdong’s Government Service and Data Management Bureau and Development and Reform Commission issued a 15th Five-Year Plan for computing power development, calling for standardized token trading rules and procedures, stronger disclosure, monitoring and risk alerts, and cross-border token settlement pilots. The plan supports dedicated token trading zones at the Guangzhou and Shenzhen data exchanges, offering end-to-end registration, listing, pricing and settlement services. It also calls for exploring data processing in China using data brought in from abroad, leveraging cross-border data policies in Hengqin, Qianhai, Nansha and Hetao, and upgrading traditional computing infrastructure into “token factories” with coordinated, flexible computing capacity across the province.

items.title: Guangdong targets gap with global leaders in single-chip computing performance
items.summary: Guangdong’s Government Service and Data Management Bureau and Development and Reform Commission issued the province’s 15th Five-Year Plan for Computing Power Development. The plan calls for tackling industrial technology bottlenecks, narrowing the performance gap with global leaders in single-chip computing, and improving heterogeneous chip integration and high-speed interconnects. Computing centers are encouraged to prioritize domestic chips to expand adoption and substitution, while supernode architectures are expected to improve chip utilization.

items.title: Guangdong to accelerate regional node under national “1+M+N” computing-power network
items.summary: Guangdong has issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for computing-power development, calling for a provincial monitoring and dispatch platform linked to national, municipal and sectoral systems. The platform will support resource monitoring, intelligent allocation and market-based trading to better match supply with demand and reduce costs and access barriers for SMEs and research institutions. The province will also explore market-based models such as computing-power banks and exchanges, support city-level public-service platforms, and accelerate its regional node under the national “1+M+N” network, with sectoral nodes initially focused on communications, energy, finance, research, civil aviation and the internet.

items.title: Inflation pressures and oil above $90 lift Bank of England December rate-hike expectations
items.summary: Investors have raised expectations for a Bank of England rate hike in December amid inflation concerns and oil prices above $90 a barrel. Renewed geopolitical risks have kept energy prices elevated. The Houthis said they attacked Saudi Arabia’s Ras Tanura refinery this week, heightening concerns that energy supply disruptions could persist. LSEG data show investors now price an 89% chance of a December hike, up from 80% on Wednesday.

items.summary: Guangdong’s Government Service and Data Management Bureau and Development and Reform Commission issued the province’s 15th Five-Year Plan for computing capacity, calling for a high-value, domestically controlled AI computing cluster in Guangzhou. The plan envisages a diversified supply of AI, supercomputing and general-purpose capacity, and fast-tracks projects including China Mobile’s Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Guangzhou) communications hub, China Unicom’s internet application innovation base, Guangzhou Lianyun Data Center and Guangzhou Huiyun Intelligent Computing Center to develop a low-latency computing and applications hub.

items.title: Guangdong targets 4,000 EFlops of intelligent computing capacity by 2030
items.summary: Guangdong’s 15th Five-Year Plan for Computing Power Development targets more than 2,500 EFlops of intelligent computing capacity by 2030, with an ambition to reach 4,000 EFlops. It also targets network latency of under 5 milliseconds between the Shaoguan cluster and major provincial cities, and calls for progress on a cross-border computing corridor with Hong Kong and Macau, higher green-power consumption and closer coordination of computing, data, power and grids.

items.title: Guangdong targets AI computing capacity above 1,000 EFLOPS by 2028
items.summary: Guangdong’s 15th Five-Year Plan for computing capacity development targets AI computing capacity above 1,000 EFLOPS (FP16) by 2028. Renewable electricity is expected to account for more than 80% of power used by the province’s data centers, while new large and larger data centers are to achieve a PUE below 1.2. The plan also calls for wider deployment of edge computing, lower network latency and better coordination between computing, data and power infrastructure.

items.title: Samsung reorganizes memory and System LSI units to accelerate AI chip push
items.summary: Samsung Electronics has moved memory R&D under the direct oversight of its memory business chief and expanded sales and marketing at its chip-design unit, System LSI, Yonhap reported, citing industry sources. The changes aim to speed development of next-generation memory and strengthen Samsung’s position in the AI chip market. Hwang Sang-joon, previously in charge of memory and DRAM R&D, was promoted to head the memory business. Yoon Ha-ryong, formerly head of memory marketing at Samsung’s Device Solutions America, was appointed to lead the company’s U.S. operations; the unit oversees Samsung’s semiconductor manufacturing in the United States.

items.title: China to counter provocations after Philippines-Australia defense pact
items.summary: China will take necessary measures to counter violations and provocations, Defense Ministry spokesperson Chen Xi said, after the Philippines and Australia signed a defense cooperation pact that some analysts say is aimed at China. Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro said the pact would strengthen Manila’s credible deterrence in areas including the South China Sea. Chen said China’s actions to safeguard its territorial sovereignty and maritime rights are lawful, and accused some Philippine politicians of escalating tensions and undermining regional stability.

items.summary: 瑞银认为，当前A股股权风险溢价较历史均值高出1.2个标准差，市场悲观情绪已为中期上涨创造条件。A股融资余额较6月底高点下降超过8100亿元，其中科技板块自10月以来减少约2000亿元，降幅23%，强制去杠杆阶段已基本结束。公募基金的交易行为可能从普遍减持转向依据盈利和估值进行个股筛选，科技板块配置比例预计不会回落至2025年年中以前的水平。 中长期资金方面，2024年9月至2026年9月，社保基金、养老金、企业年金及保险资金合计净买入A股超过1.5万亿元；截至2026年三季度末，保险资金投资股票和证券投资基金规模超过6.5万亿元，较2025年底增加8342亿元。瑞银预计，保险机构2027年将进一步提高A股配置比例。国家队买入、增量政策支持及中长期资金流入，有望共同推动A股估值逐步修复。 行业配置方面，2027年瑞银看好三类行业：科技自主可控的（重点包括电子、半导体、通信）、全球竞争力较强的出口企业（重点包括电力设备、机械）和高股息防御性行业（重点包括银行、电信运营商）。（瑞银11月26日报告，仅供参考，不构成投资建议）

items.title: Copper and silver prices slump; silver may swing to surplus after five years of deficits
items.summary: Gold prices are under pressure, while copper has slumped. Three-month LME copper hit a record above $14,800/mt in September but touched an 11-month low overnight, down nearly 18% this month. Higher Fed rate expectations and concerns about the outlook for AI infrastructure investment have weighed on prices. Industry participants say data centers account for a relatively small share of copper demand; grid investment and broader electrification are the main drivers. JP Morgan expects silver to move from five straight years of deficits to a surplus of about 30 mln oz this year, as solar-sector demand falls and high prices curb jewelry consumption. The surplus could widen to about 54 mln oz next year.

items.title: UK to spend £8 billion upgrading nuclear submarine facilities
items.summary: Britain signed an £8 billion, five-year contract with Babcock to upgrade nuclear submarine facilities, part of a government drive to ensure the country is ready for wartime operations. The defence secretary said last month Britain must be prepared for military action or deterrence missions within 1,000 days, though tight public finances pose a challenge. The contract will be the largest single procurement decision of the current parliamentary term. Inadequate maintenance facilities have forced Royal Navy nuclear submarines into longer-than-usual deployments to sustain Britain’s continuous at-sea nuclear deterrent.

items.title: 金十快讯
Cold snap drives demand, tightens UK power supply for third straight day
items.summary: The UK faced tight power supplies for a third consecutive day on Thursday as a cold snap lifted demand. The National Energy System Operator (NESO) said available generation reserves could fall below target from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time, urging generators to increase output and large power users to cut consumption. It was the fourth such alert this winter, twice the total issued over the previous five winters and the most in a single winter since 2020. Greater reliance on weather-dependent renewables leaves supplies vulnerable when cold weather boosts demand and wind generation is low. Tight supply is pushing up prices: day-ahead power for Thursday settled at £206.73/MWh, about twice this year's average.

items.title: China says tariff wars serve no one's interests, calls 'overcapacity' a false premise
items.summary: Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said tariff and trade wars serve no party's interests and that China and the United States should resolve differences through talks on an equal, respectful and mutually beneficial basis. Asked about U.S. plans to raise tariffs on Chinese imports by 20%, potentially to 40% if talks fail, Guo said the so-called overcapacity issue was a false premise and rejected its use for political purposes. China will take necessary steps to defend its legitimate rights and interests.

items.summary: China’s three major A-share indexes fell after opening higher, then recovered late. The Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.01%, the Shenzhen Composite Index fell 0.02% and the ChiNext Index gained 0.29%. Precious metals rebounded, with Shengda Resources limit-up. Fisheries stocks advanced, with Zhongshui Fisheries and Haidah Group also limit-up. Electronic components surged before paring gains; Dongjing Electronics, Sunlord Electronics and Junya Technology were among several limit-up stocks. Coal, oil and gas exploration, 6G, paper, agriculture, chemicals and banks also outperformed. Robot actuators, medical devices, software, innovative drugs, new consumer stocks and livestock farming fell. Turnover in Shanghai and Shenzhen totaled 1.31 tln yuan, down about 65.7 bln yuan from the same time a day earlier. About 1,800 stocks rose and 3,600 fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing.

items.title: German consumer confidence edges up in December but remains subdued
items.summary: German consumer confidence edged up entering December as income expectations improved slightly, but remained near historic lows, a survey showed Thursday. The Nuremberg Institute for Market Decisions (NIM) and GfK said their index rose to -30.2 from a revised -30.9 in November, below expectations for -29.9. Economic expectations fell 3.7 points to -1.6, ending a six-month run of gains. Price expectations rose 1.8 points to 2.8, while income expectations climbed 1.8 points to -13.9, nearly 14 points below a year earlier. High energy prices continue to weigh on households, and consumers remain cautious about Christmas spending.

items.summary: 【德国12月消费者信心小幅回升 但仍处于低迷水平】金十数据11月26日讯，周四公布的调查显示，随着收入预期略有改善，德国消费者信心在迈入12月之际小幅回升，但整体仍处于低位。纽伦堡市场决策研究所（NIM）与市场研究机构GfK公布的消费者信心指数从11月份修正后的-30.9点升至-30.2点，略低于市场预期的-29.9点。NIM消费者信心研究主管Rolf Buerkl表示，该指数“基本停滞在低位”，这对即将到来的圣诞购物季而言并不是一个好兆头。NIM近期一项有关圣诞礼物计划支出的研究也反映出消费者持谨慎的购买态度。11月份，经济预期指数下降3.7点，至-1.6点，结束了此前连续六个月的上升势头。与此同时，价格预期指数上升1.8点，至2.8点。收入预期指数上升1.8点，至-13.9点，但仍较一年前低近14点。能源价格尤其高企，继续给家庭带来压力。

items.title: Vietnam's first nuclear plants may be delayed until after 2035
items.summary: Vietnam's first nuclear plants may not enter service until after 2035, complicating efforts to bolster energy security and support economic growth. A draft revised power development plan released this week for public comment proposes starting operations at Ninh Thuan 1 in 2037 or 2038 and Ninh Thuan 2 in 2039 or 2040, versus a current target of 2030-35 for the first plant. Project planners, including Russia's Rosatom, estimate construction would take at least 12 years after completion of a feasibility study. State utility EVN has submitted a pre-feasibility study for Ninh Thuan 1 to the Finance Ministry. The potential delay clouds Vietnam's plan to reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels, a vulnerability underscored by this year's energy price surge following the Iran war.

items.summary: 【越南首批核电站或推迟至2035年后投运】金十数据11月26日讯，据外媒报道，越南首批核电站可能被迫推迟至2035年以后投运，这将使该国加强能源安全、推动经济增长的努力面临更大挑战。根据本周公布、供公众征求意见的越南电力发展规划修订草案，越南工贸部提议，宁顺1号核电站于2037年或2038年开始投运，宁顺2号核电站则于2039年或2040年投运。越南电力集团（EVN）已向财政部提交宁顺1号核电站的预可行性研究报告。现行规划要求该核电站在2030年至2035年间投入运营。不过，包括俄罗斯合作伙伴俄罗斯国家原子能公司在内的项目规划方评估认为，在完成可行性研究后，项目建设至少还需要12年。潜在的延期给越南发展核电的计划蒙上阴影。越南希望通过发展核电减少对进口化石燃料的依赖，而今年伊朗战争引发的能源价格飙升进一步凸显了这种依赖所带来的风险。

items.title: ING: U.S. Treasury yield decline may be overdone as market overlooks reasons for yields to rise
items.summary: ING rates strategists said the long-weekend effect may be at play and holding bonds may still be a reasonable trade, but the market has ignored several reasons for yields to rise this week. Nvidia’s reversal lower on Monday, resilient consumer confidence data on Tuesday and further signs of economic resilience on Wednesday should all have pushed yields higher, they said. While market price action must be respected, the move looks somewhat excessive given those factors. Treasury yields closed lower on Wednesday. The market is closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and will close early Friday.

items.title: Japanese short-term bond yields rise as equity rebound and hawkish BOJ remarks revive hike bets
items.summary: Japanese short-term bond yields rose Thursday as an equity rebound revived bets on a near-term Bank of Japan rate hike. Hawkish board member Naoki Tamura added to expectations for earlier tightening, saying the BOJ must respond quickly to signs inflation is overshooting its target, including by accelerating rate increases. Recent price trends point to further upside inflation risks, he said, citing the Middle East war, a weaker yen lifting import costs and resilient demand for AI-related goods. Barclays said Tamura’s remarks reinforced the case for not delaying further hikes rather than signaling a faster pace, and reiterated its call for a December hike. Options traders put the odds of a hike next month at 68%, LSEG data showed.

items.summary: 【日本短期国债收益率上涨 股市反弹及央行鹰派官员言论提振加息预期】金十数据11月26日讯，周四，日本短期国债收益率上涨，股市反弹带动市场对日本央行近期加息的押注回升。日本央行鹰派委员田村直树进一步加剧了市场对提前收紧货币政策的预期。他表示，日本央行必须“对物价出现上行偏离目标的迹象迅速作出反应，包括加快政策利率的上调步伐”。“近期的价格走势表明，通胀面临进一步上行风险。”他警告称，中东战争、日元疲软导致进口成本上升，以及人工智能相关商品需求依然强劲，都可能带来价格上涨压力。巴克莱分析师表示：“与其说田村的言论预示着加息步伐将加快，不如说他进一步强化了不应推迟后续加息的理由。”该行同时重申了对日本央行12月加息的预期。LSEG数据显示，期权交易员目前认为日本央行下月加息的概率为68%。

items.title: Options market signals growing optimism on Indian rupee
items.summary: The one-month, 25-delta risk reversal, which measures the relative cost of hedging rupee depreciation versus appreciation, turned negative on Wednesday for the first time since February, signaling rising optimism on the currency. The gauge compares implied volatility for dollar calls and puts and reached its highest level since 2022 in March. The rupee has rebounded sharply, gaining 3.5% this quarter to become Asia’s best-performing currency after record foreign inflows into Indian stocks, as investors unwind AI-related trades and lower oil prices provide support. Foreign portfolio inflows, exporters’ dollar sales and an improved external balance after oil prices fell are providing unusually strong support for the rupee, said Anindya Banerjee, head of commodity, currency and interest-rate derivatives at Kotak Neo.

items.summary: UBS expects Hong Kong asset markets to remain broadly stable in 2027, with the MSCI Hong Kong Index posting mid-single-digit growth and residential prices flat. AI-driven cost savings are more pronounced in financials and could add 5%-10% to index-level earnings growth over the next five years.

items.title: EU leaders to clash over seven-year budget and Ukraine financing, seek deal in December
items.summary: EU leaders are expected to clash on Thursday over the bloc’s 2028-34 budget, worth nearly 1.6 trillion euros ($1.76 trillion), as they seek to narrow differences ahead of a December deal. The latest proposal sets the budget at 1.582 trillion euros, including 140 billion euros for repayment of pandemic-era debt. The EU plans to raise 45 billion euros through joint borrowing for a 2027 loan to Ukraine, repayable only if Russia pays war reparations to Ukraine. Leaders aim to agree a deal at a summit on Dec. 17-18. They want to finalize it by year-end, ahead of elections next year in France, Italy, Poland, Greece, Estonia, Finland and Slovakia that could complicate negotiations.

items.summary: 【欧盟领导人将就七年期预算及乌克兰融资问题展开激烈交锋，力争12月达成协议】金十数据11月26日讯，欧盟外交官表示，欧盟领导人周四将围绕欧盟2028年至2034年近1.6万亿欧元（1.76万亿美元）的预算方案展开激烈交锋，希望缩小各方分歧，为12月达成协议创造条件。最新方案拟将欧盟2028年至2034年预算定为1.582万亿欧元，其中包括1400亿欧元疫情时期债务偿还资金。欧盟计划通过联合借款筹集450亿欧元，作为2027年对乌克兰贷款，并且只有在俄罗斯向乌克兰支付战争赔偿后才需要予以偿还。欧盟领导人希望在12月17日至18日举行的峰会上就预算协议达成一致。各国领导人希望在今年年底前敲定协议，因为明年法国、意大利、波兰、希腊、爱沙尼亚、芬兰和斯洛伐克将举行选举，这可能使谈判更加复杂。

items.title: 私募股权“买不动、卖不掉”？混合融资正成为华尔街新宠
items.summary: 在传统私募股权收购交易陷入困境之际，一种混合融资模式正成为华尔街新宠。阿波罗全球管理表示，其混合融资部门是增长最快的业务板块，管理资产规模已超过1000亿美元，接近其传统收购基金规模的两倍。黑石集团、华平投资、高盛资产管理以及中型私募股权机构也纷纷加码这一领域。 混合融资通常包括优先股、可转换融资等结构，投资者通过提供资金获得介于债权和普通股权之间的权益，目标回报率通常在十几个百分点，高于传统信贷投资，但低于经典杠杆收购。其走红主要源于传统私募股权市场面临退出难题：不少基金在利率上升前以高估值收购企业，如今却难以出售。混合融资可以帮助原投资者转让部分股权、回笼资金，同时避免资产减记。这类融资还被用于帮助企业降低杠杆、进行再融资，以及支持人工智能数据中心建设、能源生产和供应链回迁。大型企业也希望借此筹集资金，同时避免股权稀释或增加资产负债表压力。 不过，这一模式并非没有隐忧。投资者可能高估了优质企业对混合融资的需求，部分交易估值也已显得过高。许多投资者过度依赖债务式利息回报，一旦预期中的高估值无法实现，可能面临较大损失。

items.title: 金十快讯
Apple to open new Hyderabad store, taking India network to seven
items.summary: Apple will open a store in Hyderabad on Dec. 10, bringing its total of official retail stores in India to seven. India is one of the company’s fastest-growing overseas markets. The city is also home to Apple’s research and development and retail customer service teams. Local sourcing requirements had long constrained Apple’s expansion into branded direct retail in India, before policy was gradually eased. Apple launched its online store in the country in 2020 and opened its first two physical stores, in Mumbai and New Delhi, three years later. The expansion helped lift annual sales in India above $10 bln for the first time in the fiscal year ended March last year.

items.summary: 【苹果将在印度海得拉巴开设新店 印度直营店总数将达到7家】金十数据11月26日讯，苹果(AAPL.O)将于下月在印度南部城市海得拉巴开设一家新门店，继续扩大其在印度的零售网络。印度是苹果海外增长最快的市场之一。苹果周四在一份声明中表示，新门店将于12月10日开业，届时印度官方零售门店总数将达到7家。海得拉巴是印度最大城市之一，也是苹果研发团队和零售客户服务团队的所在地。多年来，印度对本地采购的要求一直阻碍苹果在当地开设标志性的直营零售店。随着相关政策逐步放宽，苹果终于在2020年于印度推出在线商店。三年后，时任CEO库克为苹果印度首批两家实体门店揭幕，分别位于孟买和新德里。这推动苹果在截至去年3月的上一财年中，印度年度销售额首次突破100亿美元。

items.title: Jefferies: U.S.-India tariffs of 17% could give Indian exporters a competitive edge
items.summary: The U.S. Trade Representative said Wednesday that tariffs on imports from India would be capped at 17% if the two countries reach a trade deal, versus 25% without an agreement. A 17% rate could give India a 1-3 percentage-point tariff advantage over emerging-market peers including Bangladesh, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, Jefferies said, potentially benefiting Indian chemical, textile and capital-goods exporters. Pharmaceuticals, energy products and some electronics and auto parts remain outside the current tariff framework but are subject to sector-specific investigations. These goods account for about 45% of India's exports to the United States.

items.title: U.S. famine early-warning network to suspend reports amid funding shortfall
items.summary: More than half of field staff at the U.S. government’s Famine Early Warning Systems Network will lose their jobs by year-end amid a funding shortfall, leaving the agency unable to help avert famines made more likely by El Nifio and cuts to international aid, people familiar with the matter said. Staff are due to receive 30-day layoff notices on Dec. 1, and the network will not publish its December food-security update because the State Department has yet to confirm funding for the fiscal year that began in October. The report is critical for famine-threatened countries including Sudan, Yemen, South Sudan and Somalia, where it was expected to identify areas worst hit by severe food shortages.

items.title: Australian business inflation expectations rise to 4.19%, above RBA target
items.summary: Australian businesses expect inflation to remain well above the Reserve Bank of Australia’s 2%-3% target over the next 12 months, despite five rate hikes this year. The CBA-Macquarie University Business Outlook survey showed the one-year inflation expectations index rising to 4.19% in November from 3.99% in October. The five-to-10-year measure also increased, to 3.86%. The report said rising expectations would keep the RBA highly vigilant as it considers its final policy decision of 2026 and the outlook for next year. The RBA raised its benchmark rate earlier this month to 4.85%, an 18-year high, to curb inflation. The survey highlights officials’ concern that CPI expectations are drifting away from the target range.

items.title: Can beverages omit production dates? China’s market regulator responds
items.summary: China’s State Administration for Market Regulation said some companies are already implementing a food-labeling standard due to take effect on March 16, 2027. It requires prepackaged foods to clearly show production and expiry dates in year-month-day order, but allows products with a shelf life of at least six months to show only the shelf life and expiry date. Companies may adopt the standard early. The response followed consumer questions about Coca-Cola bottles that list only an expiry date.

items.title: 【有饮料可以不标生产日期？市场监管总局回应】金十数据11月26日讯，近日，有消费者发现，部分可口可乐瓶身仅标注保质期到期日，未标注生产日期，因而对产品标签标注方
items.summary: 【有饮料可以不标生产日期？市场监管总局回应】金十数据11月26日讯，近日，有消费者发现，部分可口可乐瓶身仅标注保质期到期日，未标注生产日期，因而对产品标签标注方式提出疑问。为什么现在有的食品只标保质期到期日、不标生产日期？市场监管总局食品生产经营司回应：这并非企业在标签上遗漏信息，而是提前执行新的食品安全国家标准。即将于2027年3月16日实施的《食品安全国家标准预包装食品标签通则》（GB7718—2025）规定：预包装食品应按照年、月、日的顺序清晰标示生产日期和保质期到期日；保质期6个月及以上的，可仅标示保质期和保质期到期日。在标准正式实施前，企业可提前执行。

items.title: Japan protests U.S. plan for 15% tariffs, denies excess capacity
items.summary: Japan protested the U.S. plan to impose 15% tariffs on Japanese imports over alleged manufacturing overcapacity, saying it has no non-market policies or practices and no structural excess capacity. Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara called the move regrettable. Washington said Wednesday it could raise the rate to 20%. The proposed tariffs and potential increase are consistent with terms of last year’s U.S.-Japan investment deal, which set a 15% tariff on Japanese goods and a lower rate for autos. Japan agreed to a $550 bln investment program in the United States.

items.title: 【日本抗议美拟对日商品征收15%关税 称不存在产能过剩】金十数据11月26日讯， 日本政府发言人表示，针对美国计划以应对制造业产能过剩为由，对来自日本的进口商品
items.summary: 【日本抗议美拟对日商品征收15%关税 称不存在产能过剩】金十数据11月26日讯， 日本政府发言人表示，针对美国计划以应对制造业产能过剩为由，对来自日本的进口商品征收15%关税，日本已向美国提出抗议，尽管这一新税率与两国此前达成的关税协议一致。 日本内阁官房长官木原稔周四表示：“日本不存在任何非市场政策或做法，也不存在结构性产能过剩。美国宣布拟采取针对日本的措施令人遗憾。我们已经向美方表达了这一立场。” 美国周三宣布，计划以应对所谓制造业产能过剩为由，对日本进口商品征收15%的关税，同时不排除将税率提高至20%的可能性。 拟议税率及可能的上调幅度均符合日美两国去年达成的一项投资协议中的约定。根据该协议，特朗普对日本商品设定了15%的关税税率，并对汽车征收较低关税。作为交换，日本同意设立一项规模达5500亿美元的投资计划，以促进对美投资。

items.title: 美国发电会多烧多少天然气？花旗测算三种情景
items.summary: 花旗测算，在基准情景下，2026至2030年美国发电用气需求将增加每日约174亿立方英尺，2031至2040年还会再增加约360亿立方英尺。该行预计，数据中心占2026至2040年美国新增用电量的约68%，燃气发电贡献同期新增发电量的约62%。需要全天供电的数据中心及先进制造是新增基荷的主要来源，花旗预计燃气、核电和地热将承担这部分负荷。 需求量对数据中心用电相当敏感。若用电较基准高约20%，花旗测算2026至2030年新增发电用气将达到每日约188亿立方英尺。若低约30%，增量则降至约120亿立方英尺。上述数字均为花旗按发电结构和负荷情景计算的发电用气需求增量。

items.title: CBA: Dollar to be key driver of gold prices in coming months
items.summary: CBA analyst Vivek Dhar said the dollar’s trajectory will be a key driver of gold prices in the coming months. As “sell America” and dollar-debasement trades give way to traditional market relationships, including gold’s inverse correlations with the dollar and U.S. 10-year real Treasury yields, structural safe-haven demand has become less important. The dollar has risen faster than CBA expected and is now close to the peak the bank had forecast for mid-2027, suggesting limited downside risk for gold, Dhar said. CBA expects gold to trade at around $3,500-$3,700 an ounce at year-end.

items.title: Singapore rejects U.S. overcapacity findings, seeks ways to lower tariffs
items.summary: Singapore rejected U.S. findings that its policies have caused manufacturing overcapacity and will urge Washington to reconsider proposed tariffs of up to 20% on its exports. The Ministry of Trade and Industry said the U.S. Trade Representative’s investigation failed to account for the structure of Singapore’s economy. Singapore does not protect its domestic market or subsidize manufactured exports, the ministry said, adding it would continue constructive engagement with the USTR and explore ways to lower tariffs. The U.S. trade surplus with Singapore widened to $33 billion in 2025.

items.title: 金十快讯
Japanese Life Insurers Cut FX Hedges to Record Low, Adding Headwind for Yen
items.summary: Japan’s nine largest life insurers hedged 43.3% of overseas assets through derivatives in 1H, the lowest level since records began in 2011. FX derivatives fell 7.6% in the six months to Sept. 30, outpacing a 1.5% decline in overseas securities holdings. Lower hedging reduces demand for yen, complicating efforts by Japanese authorities to support the currency. Amir Anvarzadeh, a strategist at Singapore-based Asymmetric Advisors, said insurers were not hedging because they expected the Fed to raise rates and the dollar to remain strong, adding that they had abandoned their bets on the yen.

items.summary: 【日本寿险巨头外汇对冲降至历史低位 日元支撑面临阻力】金十数据11月26日讯，日本大力推动日元走强的努力正面临一大阻力。日本最大的几家寿险公司在本财年上半年将外汇对冲比例降至历史最低水平。据分析，截至9月30日的六个月内，日本九大寿险公司合计通过衍生品对冲了其海外资产持有量的43.3%，这是自2011年有数据记录以来的最低水平。同期，外汇衍生品规模下降7.6%，降幅超过海外证券持仓1.5%的跌幅。这再次凸显日本当局试图支撑日元面临的艰巨任务。由于海外资产的外汇对冲实际上是通过衍生品建立的日元多头头寸，因此削减对冲规模会减少对日元的需求，与日本当局支撑日元的努力背道而驰。新加坡Asymmetric Advisors策略师Amir Anvarzadeh表示：“寿险公司不进行对冲，是因为它们认为美联储将加息，而且美元将继续保持强势。它们已经放弃了对日元的押注。”

items.title: Citigroup: Australian domestic demand growth has exceeded potential, leaving further rate hikes a risk
items.summary: Australian private business investment surged 12% QoQ in Q3, its biggest quarterly gain since the 2011 mining boom and well above the 4.3% consensus forecast. Equipment, plant and machinery investment jumped 23%, reflecting strong AI-related spending. Citigroup chief economist Josh Williamson said domestic demand may have risen as much as 1.5% in Q3, lifting annual economic growth to 3.3%—an overheated pace. Demand is now growing faster than potential, while the AI investment boom is competing for land, labor and capital. Williamson expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to hold its cash rate at 4.85%, but sees a risk of further hikes.

items.title: A shares midday: ChiNext pares gains to 0.06%; electronic components rebound sharply
items.summary: China’s three main equity indexes pared early gains by midday; the ChiNext Index had risen more than 2% intraday. The Shanghai Composite fell 0.03%, the Shenzhen Composite Index gained 0.15% and ChiNext rose 0.06%. Electronic components rebounded sharply, with Jinbaize surging 20% to its daily limit and several stocks, including Dongjing Electronics and Shennan Circuits, hitting their limits. Aquaculture stocks strengthened, with China National Fisheries and Haidangjia both at their daily limits. 6G stocks advanced after China issued an implementation plan for next-generation communications network construction; Plite hit its daily limit. Precious metals, oil and gas extraction, coal, minor metals, chemical materials, agriculture and CPO stocks also outperformed. Humanoid robots, blind-box retail, film and cinema, innovative drugs, education and physical AI stocks fell. Turnover across Shanghai and Shenzhen was about 796.3 billion yuan, up 33.2 billion yuan from the same period a day earlier. About 2,400 stocks rose and 2,900 fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing.

items.title: 美国财富分配过去十多年明显改变，股市对美联储政策的影响在上升
items.summary: 美国经济增长与普通家庭实际获得的收入、财富之间出现越来越大的差距，导致传统货币政策的传导机制发生变化。美国中产阶级的财富占比持续下降：1989年以来，美国收入在中间50%—90%群体的净资产占比从36%降至29%，而90%—99.99%（即收入最高的10%）群体从61%升至69%。 年轻一代越来越依赖股票投资积累退休财富。股票市场已成为家庭财富的重要来源，央行越来越难以通过制造股市熊市来抑制需求。换而言之，2027—2028年财政纪律预计仍难以明显恢复，而战争结束、关税取消虽然有助于中产消费，也可能重新推高通胀，使未来两年通胀和利率维持较高水平。（TS Lombard 11月25日报告，仅供参考，不构成投资建议）

items.title: Japan receives first shipment of bio-LNG from Malaysia
items.summary: Tokyo Gas received about 40,000 cubic meters of bio-LNG from Malaysia’s Petronas at its Ogishima LNG terminal, the first such shipment to Japan. The volume is about one-third of a standard LNG cargo. Made by liquefying purified renewable methane, bio-LNG can be produced from agricultural waste and has lower carbon emissions than conventional LNG. Japanese energy companies are testing alternative fuels to cut emissions while continuing to use existing fossil-fuel infrastructure.

items.summary: 【日本首次接收马来西亚生物液化天然气】金十数据11月26日讯， 日本首次接收来自马来西亚的生物液化天然气，标志着日本在推动能源结构脱碳方面迈出一步。日本目前的能源结构仍以化石燃料为主。 根据东京燃气周四发布的一份声明，该公司已从马来西亚国有企业国家石油公司（Petronas）接收约4万立方米的可再生燃料，运抵其扇岛液化天然气接收站。这一数量约为标准液化天然气船货装载量的三分之一。 生物液化天然气是经过提纯的可再生甲烷液化后形成的燃料，可利用农业废弃物生产，因此与传统液化天然气相比，其碳排放量较低。这是日本能源企业正在试用的多种替代燃料之一。日本能源企业希望在降低排放的同时，继续利用价值数十亿美元的现有化石燃料基础设施。

items.title: Asian currencies seen rangebound as U.S. details tariffs
items.summary: Asian currencies are likely to remain rangebound as a new U.S. tariff push revives trade uncertainty, Maybank analysts said. Fraying trade ties are weighing on the dollar, with the DXY down since the tariffs first came into focus. The Trump administration has proposed tariffs on 14 economies, citing excess manufacturing capacity, with Vietnam facing the highest rate, followed by India. Exemptions, particularly for semiconductors and pharmaceuticals, could soften the impact on Taiwan, South Korea, Singapore and Malaysia, while negotiations may also yield lower rates. Hearings are set to begin in late January, and tariff uncertainty could persist well into Q1 2027.

items.summary: 【机构：美国公布关税细节之际，亚洲货币料将维持盘整】金十数据11月26日讯，马来亚银行分析师表示，随着美国新一轮关税攻势重新引发贸易不确定性，亚洲货币将继续维持盘整。贸易关系趋于破裂对美元不利，自这些关税首次受到关注以来，美元指数DXY已下跌。特朗普政府已提议以制造业产能过剩为由，对14个经济体征收关税。在拟议税率中，越南面临的税率最高，其次是印度。马来亚银行指出，产品豁免——尤其是针对半导体和药品的豁免——可能减轻对中国台湾地区、韩国、新加坡和马来西亚的影响。此外，谈判也可能促成潜在税率下调。听证会定于1月底开始，与关税相关的不确定性可能持续到2027年第一季度相当长一段时间。

items.title: OCBC adds gold vault to expand physical gold capabilities
items.summary: OCBC has added a gold vault with capacity of about 100 metric tons, or roughly 8,000 bars weighing 12.4 kg each, to meet rising demand for physical gold trading and custody. OCBC is also exploring expansion of physical gold and related investment and hedging solutions across more business lines.

items.title: Bank of Korea rate projections signal further hikes
items.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate by 25 bps to 3.25% on Thursday, with two policymakers dissenting. Its rate projections were hawkish: 15 of 21 forecasts see rates above current levels in six months, including eight at 3.50% and seven at 3.75%, suggesting some policymakers expect a higher peak than the 3.50% widely anticipated by markets. The central bank expects inf to remain above its 2% target for an extended period and said future hikes will depend on inf, economic conditions and financial stability. Faster household loan growth and elevated home-price expectations are adding to financial stability concerns. Semiconductor-led exports and investment support growth, though the scale of the chip-sector expansion remains uncertain. Analyst Eamonn Sheridan said the hawkish projections could support the won, keep short-term bond yields elevated and weigh on property and consumer stocks.

items.summary: 【韩国央行释放鹰派信号，15份预测指向进一步加息】金十数据11月26日讯，韩国央行周四将基准利率上调25个基点至3.25%，其中两名委员投下反对票。不过，央行委员会的利率预测整体偏向鹰派：21份预测中，有15份认为未来六个月利率将高于当前水平，其中8份指向3.50%，7份指向3.75%，显示部分决策者预计利率峰值将高于市场此前普遍预期的3.50%。韩国央行预计通胀将在较长时间内高于2%的目标，并表示未来加息将取决于通胀、经济和金融稳定状况。家庭贷款增长加快、房价上涨预期居高不下，也令金融稳定风险受到关注；半导体行业带动的出口和投资强劲，为经济增长提供支撑，但芯片产业扩张的规模仍是关键不确定因素。分析师Eamonn Sheridan指出，偏鹰派的利率预期可能支撑韩元、推动短期国债收益率维持高位，并给房地产和消费类股票带来压力。

items.title: Chinese researchers contribute to first direct detection of cosmic 21-cm signal
items.summary: The international MeerKLASS collaboration has directly detected the neutral hydrogen 21-cm radio signal on cosmological scales for the first time, using South Africa’s MeerKAT radio telescope, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 6.2. The result advances 21-cm intensity mapping toward independent cosmological research and supports future precision observations with the Square Kilometre Array. The findings were published online in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society. Researchers at the Shanghai Astronomical Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences led development of a key data-calibration pipeline.

items.summary: 【国家卫健委：健康体检机构不得提供明确禁止或无明确意义的检查检验项目】金十数据11月26日讯，国家卫健委办公厅发布关于进一步优化健康体检服务的通知，其中提出，健康体检机构要规范健康体检项目管理，根据受检者年龄、性别和检前咨询评估情况推荐适宜的健康体检项目。严格遵循知情同意和自愿原则，不得提供明确禁止或无明确意义的检查检验项目，不得强制受检者接受体检项目。优化体检场地布局和服务流程，提高体检服务效率，规范出具并及时反馈健康体检报告，对体检异常结果进行明确标注和解释说明。探索实施体检结果风险程度分级管理制度，提出通俗易懂、有针对性的意见建议。

items.title: South Korea weighs measures to support domestic EV industry
items.summary: South Korea is considering measures to bolster its EV industry amid intensifying competition, including tax credits for EVs produced and sold domestically. The government plans to announce the measures at a meeting whose timing has not been set; reports that it would take place Friday were premature. The Finance and Economy Ministry opposed including EVs in a proposed domestic-production tax credit at a parliamentary tax subcommittee meeting this week, citing administrative inefficiency and an overly broad scope. It said additional EV tax incentives were unnecessary, as locally produced models remained price-competitive and South Korea already had an established EV manufacturing base.

items.summary: 【韩国拟出台措施扶持本土电动车产业】金十数据11月26日讯，据外媒报道，韩国财政经济部表示，鉴于国内汽车制造商面临日益激烈的竞争，韩国预计将宣布一系列措施，以支持其电动汽车产业的竞争力。正在讨论的措施中包括针对在韩国生产和销售的电动汽车提供税收抵免。这项政策预计将在政府主导的一场会议上公布。韩国财政部周三晚间声明表示，会议时间尚未确定，此前曾有消息称会议将于周五举行。据韩国《每日经济新闻》周二援引消息报道，在本周举行的一场国会税收小组委员会会议上，财政部反对将电动汽车纳入拟议中的国内生产税收抵免计划，理由是担心这会造成行政效率低下，并可能导致适用范围过于宽泛。该部还表示认为没有必要为电动汽车提供额外的税收优惠，理由是本土生产的车型在价格上仍能与其他进口车型竞争，且韩国已经拥有成熟的电动汽车制造基地。

items.title: Eight departments to expand transport, winter tourism and TCM services to spur new growth in Northeast China
items.summary: MOFCOM and seven other departments issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Trade in Services, calling for stronger regional specialization and growth in service exports. Priorities include linking central China’s machinery and intelligent-equipment exports with services, and expanding digital and green trade. Western China will leverage new land-sea corridors to develop logistics, digital services, cultural trade and traditional Chinese medicine services. In Northeast China, the plan calls for extending manufacturing value chains into R&D, design, supply-chain management and after-sales services, building a key service hub for Northeast Asian supply chains, and expanding transport, winter tourism and traditional Chinese medicine services to support regional revitalization. Border regions will be encouraged to develop cross-border transport, tourism, international healthcare and services in less commonly spoken languages.

items.title: Eight Chinese agencies call for innovation in digital finance, online education, telemedicine and microdramas
items.summary: MOFCOM and seven other agencies issued China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for trade in services, calling for national digital trade demonstration zones, stronger digital services export bases and digital trade clusters. The plan supports broader digital services, products and technology exports, international data services and development of the data services value chain, while calling for orderly opening of the digital sector, greater investment and operating facilitation, and participation in international rule-making. It also calls for innovation in digital finance, online education, telemedicine and microdramas, and faster growth in digitally ordered services trade.

items.title: New York Fed removes ANZ from FX counterparty list
items.summary: ANZ has been removed from the New York Fed’s list of FX counterparties, leaving Commonwealth Bank of Australia as the only Australian bank among the 21 institutions that conduct FX operations for the Fed and U.S. Treasury. The change took effect on Nov. 25; the New York Fed gave no reason. Banks must be significant FX market-makers and meet operational requirements to qualify. Credit Suisse was the last bank removed, in September 2023.

items.summary: 【纽约联储将澳新银行移出外汇交易对手名单】金十数据11月26日讯，纽约联储表示，澳大利亚澳新银行集团已被移出其外汇交易对手名单。澳新银行被移除后，澳大利亚联邦银行成为该名单中唯一一家澳大利亚银行。该名单共包括21家银行，这些银行代表美联储和美国财政部开展外汇交易操作。纽约联储并未说明将澳新银行移出名单的原因。根据其网站信息，这一调整于11月25日生效。澳新银行是澳大利亚市值排名第四的银行，也是该国“四大银行”中市值最小的一家。要获得外汇交易对手资格，银行必须满足一系列要求，包括在外汇市场拥有重要的做市商地位，能够提供双向流动性。此外，银行还必须具备规模足够大、经验丰富的后台运营团队，以确认交易并安排与纽约联储之间的结算，同时能够处理纽约联储要求的交易量。上一次有银行被移出名单是在2023年9月，当时被移除的是瑞士信贷。

items.title: Eight Chinese departments to deepen implementation of cross-border services trade negative list and orderly opening of telecoms, healthcare and other sectors
items.summary: MOFCOM and seven other departments issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Services Trade, calling for deeper implementation of the cross-border services trade negative list, stronger oversight and risk monitoring in key and sensitive sectors, and improved regulation of cross-border factor flows. China will orderly expand opening in value-added telecoms, healthcare and other sectors, attract more international firms and service businesses, and advance comprehensive pilot programs for opening the services sector. The plan also calls for upgrading the mainland’s economic partnership arrangements with Hong Kong and Macao, leveraging their status as separate customs territories and free ports.

items.title: BOJ's Tamura says rate hikes should accelerate to counter upside inflation risks
items.summary: BOJ board member Naoki Tamura said Thursday the central bank must respond quickly to signs of inflation overshooting, including by accelerating rate hikes. With financial conditions still loose, the policy rate should be raised promptly to a level considered neutral for the economy, he said. Higher input costs, including oil prices driven up by the Middle East conflict, have sharply lifted wholesale inflation, with price pressures spreading across a broad range of consumer goods. Recent price trends point to further upside risks, while Japan's inflation expectations are less firmly anchored than those in other economies, reinforcing the case for further hikes. Surveys suggest past and potential future BOJ rate increases are unlikely to significantly disrupt business activity. With underlying CPI inflation not yet firmly anchored at the 2% target, the BOJ must quickly respond to signs of an overshoot, including by accelerating rate increases, Tamura said.

items.summary: 【日本央行审议委员：应加快加息步伐 应对通胀上行风险】金十数据11月26日讯，日本央行审议委员田村直树周四表示，面对通胀超预期上行的迹象，必须迅速作出反应，包括加快加息步伐。他表示：“鉴于金融环境仍然宽松，我认为日本央行需要尽快将政策利率提高至被认为对经济具有中性影响的水平。”田村直树称，原材料成本上涨，包括中东冲突导致原油价格走高，已推动批发通胀大幅上升，价格压力正逐渐蔓延至种类广泛的消费品。“近期的价格走势表明，通胀面临进一步上行风险。”他表示，日本通胀预期的锚定程度不如其他经济体稳固，这进一步凸显了继续加息的必要性。金融环境仍然宽松。调查显示，日本央行此前的加息以及未来可能采取的进一步加息举措，不太可能对企业经营活动造成巨大冲击。“鉴于日本的潜在CPI通胀尚未稳固锚定在2%的目标水平，央行必须对物价出现上行偏离目标的迹象迅速作出反应，包括加快政策利率的上调步伐。”

items.summary: 【专家：我国服务贸易呈现持续增长、结构向优良好态势】金十数据11月26日讯，服务贸易是当今国际贸易中最具活力的部分。习近平经济思想研究中心研究四部主任、研究员张燕在新华社11月26日推出的“中国经济圆桌会”大型全媒体访谈节目中说，今年以来，我国服务贸易呈现持续增长、结构向优的良好态势，成为对外开放中最具活力的板块之一。张燕说，今年前三季度，我国服务进出口总额近5.8万亿元，同比增长8.5%。其中服务出口增长14.8%，远高于进口增速，服务贸易逆差进一步收窄。谈及服务贸易新亮点，张燕表示，主要有三个方面：一是“中国智慧”加速出海。今年前三季度，我国知识密集型服务出口1.2万亿元，增长11.7%，占服务出口的比重达到53.7%。

items.title: AI-heavy bets battered as Situational Awareness loses 65% in Q3
items.summary: Hedge fund Situational Awareness lost 65% after fees in the third quarter, the Wall Street Journal reported. Founder Leopold Aschenbrenner told investors the fund was still up 88.5% after fees year to date through Sept. 30 and continued to see investments with high return potential. He said recent turmoil had prompted more cautious risk management: “Volatility is acceptable, but we must never take risks that threaten survival, even if we are completely wrong.” A brief AI scare in July triggered margin calls from banks and brought the fund close to collapse. It ultimately sold most of its public-equity portfolio to Citadel. The reported performance does not reflect October’s market selloff.

items.summary: 【AI投资重仓押注遭遇重创 Situational Awareness三季度亏损65%】金十数据11月26日讯，据《华尔街日报》报道，对冲基金Situational Awareness告知投资者，该基金第三季度扣除费用后亏损65%。创始人Leopold Aschenbrenner在一封致投资者信函中表示，截至9月底，该基金今年以来扣除费用后仍上涨88.5%。但该基金仍认为，市场上存在具有较高回报潜力的投资机会。Aschenbrenner在信中表示，他已从近期的动荡中吸取教训，正在采取更加审慎的风险管理方式。他表示：“波动性可以接受，但绝不能承担可能危及生存的风险，即使我们完全判断错误也不例外。”今年7月，市场对人工智能的短暂恐慌情绪席卷全球市场，银行随之发出追加保证金通知，Situational Awareness一度濒临崩溃。最终，该公司将其公开市场股票投资组合中的大部分资产出售给城堡投资。此次信函中提及的业绩并未反映10月份市场的抛售行情。

items.title: Capital Economics: Bank of Korea may have delivered final rate hike of current cycle
items.summary: After the Bank of Korea’s third rate hike this year, Capital Economics said the tightening cycle is likely near its end or already over. Economist Gareth Leather said the bank’s main concern is inflation, which has remained above its 2% target since the Iran conflict began. He expects inflation to move back toward target early next year as base effects from the energy shock fade. Growth has been concentrated in capital-intensive industries, while strong productivity gains should limit domestic price pressures from rapid GDP growth. A sharp rebound in the won should also ease concerns about imported inflation.

items.title: Bank of Korea hikes rates for third time this year as AI boom fuels growth
items.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark seven-day repo rate by 25 bps to 3.25% on Thursday, its third hike this year, as inf remains above its 2% target and stronger growth adds to price pressures. AI-driven semiconductor exports have lifted growth and given the central bank more room to tighten. It raised its growth forecasts to 3.9% for 2026 and 4.1% for 2027, from 3.3% and 2.9% in August. It expects headline inf to average 2.7% this year and 2.4% next year, versus previous forecasts of 2.7% and 2.3%.

items.title: 【韩国央行在AI热潮推动经济增长之际重启加息】金十数据11月26日讯，韩国央行今年第三次上调利率，目前通胀率仍远高于目标，经济增长加快也促使该央行再次上调经济预
items.summary: 【韩国央行在AI热潮推动经济增长之际重启加息】金十数据11月26日讯，韩国央行今年第三次上调利率，目前通胀率仍远高于目标，经济增长加快也促使该央行再次上调经济预测。韩国央行周四在今年最后一次利率决策会议上将基准7天期回购利率上调25个基点至3.25%，此前该央行已在7月和8月加息。韩国经济显著受益于AI投资热潮，该热潮将出口推至新高。但由此带来的经济强劲势头也存在助长通胀的风险，而当前的通胀水平对韩国央行而言已令人不安。韩国央行目前预计，2026年经济增速将达3.9%，2027年为4.1%，高于其8月份预测的3.3%和2.9%；预计整体消费者价格通胀率今年平均为2.7%，明年为2.4%，此前预测分别为2.7%和2.3%，这两项预测均高于该央行2%的目标。受AI需求推动，半导体出口强劲帮助该国经济增长快于预期，也给韩国央行更大加息空间以遏制通胀。

items.title: Lithium hydroxide: Market likely to be driven by structural swings, with three key variables
items.summary: A Southwest Futures report said lithium hydroxide futures are unlikely to enter a sustained bull market over the medium to long term, with price action more likely to be driven by structural swings. Key variables are changes in high-nickel ternary battery penetration, which shape demand; lithium concentrate prices, which anchor valuation; and the arbitrage spread between lithium salts, which determines the pace of supply response. The market is expected to remain in weak balance in 2026-27, with excess capacity typically capping price gains. But stronger-than-expected high-nickel orders, mine supply disruptions or concentrated production switches and cuts could trigger rapid destocking and a short-term futures rebound. Compared with lithium carbonate futures, lithium hydroxide is a smaller, more structurally driven and higher-beta market, making it more suited to swing trading and relative-value positioning.

items.title: 氢氧化锂：核心行情或以结构性波段为主，核心锚定三大变量！
items.summary: 金十期货11月26日讯，西南期货研报指出，综合供需平衡与期货定价逻辑，中长期来看，氢氧化锂期货或难以走出单边趋势性牛市，核心行情或以结构性波段为主，核心锚定三大变量：一是高镍三元渗透率的边际变化，决定需求端景气度；二是锂精矿原料价格走势，决定品种估值底部区间；三是两盐价差套利空间，决定供给端弹性释放节奏。短期2026-2027年，行业维持弱平衡格局，常态下过剩产能压制价格上行高度，但一旦出现高镍订单超预期、矿端供给扰动、集中转产减产等情况，市场将快速去库，推动期货盘面阶段性反弹。相较于碳酸锂期货，氢氧化锂期货小众化、结构化、弹性更强的特征，将使其更容易走出独立行情，适合波段交易与结构性配置。 （本内容及观点仅供参考，不构成任何投资建议）

items.title: China targets leading next-generation communications network by 2030, including 6G
items.summary: China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration and National Development and Reform Commission issued a plan to build a next-generation communications network by 2030, with leading performance and broad coverage. The network will be anchored by 5G-Advanced/6G, 10-gigabit optical networks and satellite internet, and will include basic, space, international and converged networks. The plan calls for global service capabilities in space networks, stronger international-network resilience and scaled deployment of converged networks, while upgrading the infrastructure to support AI development and improve intelligence, security, resilience and energy efficiency.

items.title: China lithium hydroxide futures debut; listing benchmark seen in line with expectations
items.summary: Guangzhou Futures Exchange’s sixth contract, lithium hydroxide futures, began trading Nov. 26. Analysts said the initial listing benchmarks were reasonable: the benchmark was 1,750 yuan/mt below the Nov. 25 spot price of 76,750 yuan/mt. The first-listed contract, LI2706, reflects expected supply and demand in June 2027 rather than current spot conditions, one analyst said. Lithium carbonate and lithium hydroxide prices remain within cost-conversion constraints, while hydroxide’s demand outlook is weaker, with high-nickel demand growth subdued and solid-state batteries not yet at scale. Hydroxide smelting capacity is ample. Based on the Nov. 25 close of the lithium carbonate January 2027 futures contract and the hydroxide listing benchmark, the futures spread was about 7,600 yuan/mt; the spot spread was about 9,150 yuan/mt.

items.author: 期货日报
items.summary: 【氢氧化锂期货今日上市交易！业内人士认为挂牌基准价符合市场预期】金十期货11月26日讯，新能源金属期货板块再添新成员，广期所第六个期货品种——氢氧化锂期货11月26日上市交易。 1. 业内人士认为，氢氧化锂期货首批合约的挂牌基准价较为合理，符合市场预期。“11月25日氢氧化锂现货价格为76750元/吨，期货挂牌基准价较现货贴水1750元/吨，贴水幅度不大，定价较为合理。”国信期货分析师李祥英告诉记者，LI2706作为首个挂牌合约，锚定的是2027年6月的供需格局，而非现货行情，1750元/吨的基差处于可接受区间。 2. 广发期货分析师林嘉旎认为，目前碳酸锂与氢氧化锂价差相对平稳，在成本转化约束范围内。碳酸锂中长期需求增长点更多锚定储能，而氢氧化锂下游高镍板块增长预期相对平淡，固态电池仍未进入规模化节点。目前氢氧化锂冶炼产能相对充足，整体驱动较碳酸锂更弱。以11月25日碳酸锂期货2701合约收盘价和氢氧化锂期货挂牌基准价计算，两者价差约为7600元/吨。目前现货市场电池级碳酸锂和氢氧化锂价差约为9150元/吨，处于合理区间。 （本内容及观点仅供参考，不构成任何投资建议）

items.title: Persian Gulf oil exports remain under pressure as crude prices reprice geopolitical risk
items.summary: Oil prices steadied early Thursday after rising for two straight sessions, as ongoing military conflict in the Middle East threatened a recovery in regional crude exports and raised concerns over supply disruptions. WTI hovered near $84 a barrel after gaining more than 4% over the previous two sessions. Brent settled below $95. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have continued, including on Ras Tanura, a major oil export hub. Iran also said two tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz struck mines on Nov. 25. “As long as the conflict remains unresolved, crude prices should retain some risk premium,” said Ryan McKay, senior commodity strategist at TD Securities, adding that Persian Gulf oil exports have declined following repeated Iranian attacks. Trading is expected to be thin on Thursday due to the Thanksgiving holiday.

items.title: Trump officials briefly considered using Cold War law to reinstate Huang
items.summary: Pentagon leaders briefly considered invoking the Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO during discussions last weekend, the Washington Post reported, citing three people familiar with the matter. The Cold War-era law gives the president broad powers to intervene in the economy. Officials said restoring Huang was vital to U.S. national security, but Nvidia’s board did not view the remarks as threats. Trump and Vice President JD Vance increasingly recognized Nvidia’s importance to the U.S. economy and Huang’s role in stabilizing financial markets, two people familiar with the discussions said.

items.summary: 【为让黄仁勋复职 特朗普政府一度考虑动用冷战法律】金十数据11月26日讯，据华盛顿邮报报道，三名知情人士透露，特朗普政府高级官员上周末就深陷争议的英伟达展开讨论期间， 五角大楼领导层曾考虑一项大胆方案：援引一项冷战时期的法律——《国防生产法》，向英伟达施压，要求公司恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务 。《国防生产法》于1950年通过，赋予美国总统广泛的经济干预权力，历史上主要用于在战争或国家紧急状态期间动员私营企业为军方提供物资。特朗普第一任期内，政府曾援引该法案，要求通用汽车在新冠疫情期间生产呼吸机。据一名了解英伟达董事会想法的人士透露，政府官员在讨论中强调，恢复黄仁勋职务对美国国家安全至关重要，但英伟达董事会并未将这些表态视为威胁。另外两名了解相关讨论的人士表示，特朗普和万斯逐渐认识到英伟达对美国经济的重要性，以及黄仁勋独特的领导能力对于稳定金融市场的作用。

items.title: Russia says it hit Ukrainian energy facilities; Kyiv says it struck Russian military airfield
items.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry said on the 25th that Russian forces struck targets in 149 areas over the previous day, including energy and transport infrastructure used by Ukrainian forces, defence industry facilities and temporary deployment sites for Ukrainian troops and foreign fighters. Russian air defences intercepted or shot down 863 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones. Ukraine’s General Staff reported 203 clashes along the front over the previous day and said Ukrainian forces struck Russian troop and equipment concentrations. It said Ukrainian forces also hit a Russian military airfield in the Nizhny Novgorod region, with preliminary reports indicating five Russian aircraft were damaged.

items.title: iQIYI Gets Nasdaq Notice Over $1 Minimum Bid Price, Has 180 Days to Regain Compliance
items.summary: iQIYI (IQ.O) said it received a written notice from Nasdaq on Nov. 25 for falling short of the $1 minimum bid price requirement. The company has 180 calendar days, through May 24, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining an ADS closing bid of at least $1 for 10 consecutive trading days. iQIYI said the notice is procedural and does not immediately trigger delisting or a trading halt. Its ADSs will continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker IQ, with no impact on operations or SEC reporting obligations.

items.summary: 【爱奇艺收纳斯达克通知 股价不足1美元需在180天内修复】金十数据11月26日讯，爱奇艺(IQ.O)宣布，公司于11月25日收到纳斯达克上市资格部门发出的书面通知，指出其不符合纳斯达克上市规则中关于最低买入价1美元的要求。通知指出，爱奇艺获得180个日历日的宽限期，即截至2027年5月24日，以重新满足上市要求。为恢复合规，爱奇艺美国存托股份（ADS）收盘买入价必须连续至少10个交易日达到或高于每股1美元。爱奇艺表示，该通知属于纳斯达克上市规则下的标准程序性通知，仅意味着公司存在合规缺陷，并不会立即导致其退市或暂停交易。目前，公司ADS仍将在纳斯达克全球精选市场以现有股票代码继续上市交易。收到该通知不会影响公司的业务、运营或向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）履行信息披露义务。

items.summary: 【美股尾盘收复失地 亚洲市场有望跟随反弹】金十数据11月26日讯，亚洲股市期货显示，周四开盘有望小幅上涨。此前华尔街尾盘反弹，使纳斯达克100指数暂时避免跌入熊市，而市场对人工智能投资热潮可持续性的担忧仍挥之不去，推动美国国债走高。近几周，投资者对人工智能基础设施建设的风险、成本及盈利前景产生疑虑，导致全球股市剧烈震荡。不过，周三逢低买盘的出现表明，尽管市场疑虑仍然存在，投资者依然相信人工智能能够成为经济增长引擎。衡量市场波动程度的一项重要指标VIX指数一度升至28，显示市场压力正在加剧。StoneX Trading及Forex.com分析师Fawad Razaqzada表示：“投资者仍在解除杠杆化风险头寸，并转向债券及其他避险资产，市场高波动性目前仍看不到结束的迹象。”

items.title: Anthropic Becomes Wall Street BUZZ as Analysts at Same Firm Split
items.summary: Two analysts at Hedgeye Risk Management have sharply diverging views on Anthropic. Communications and software analyst Andrew Freedman said Wednesday that the stock was at an attractive level for long-term investors, citing its potential to become a new operating system for businesses and strong near-term demand. Global technology analyst Felix Wang recommended shorting the stock in a report to clients Tuesday, citing mounting difficulty financing data centers needed to secure computing capacity and concerns about long-term demand for Anthropic’s AI models. Wang sees the stock falling to $59; Freedman’s fair-value target is $92.

items.summary: 【同一家机构给出相反评级 Anthropic成华尔街多空分歧焦点】金十数据11月26日讯，华尔街同一家研究机构的两名股票分析师罕见地对当前市场最热门的股票之一——Anthropi，给出了截然相反的前景判断。一方面，Hedgeye Risk Management的通信与软件分析师Andrew Freedman周三在接受采访时表示，目前该股股价处于对长期投资者具有吸引力的水平。另一方面，他的同事、全球科技分析师Felix Wang周二向客户发送报告，建议做空该股。Wang的悲观看法主要基于两方面：Anthropic赖以获取算力的数据中心融资难度日益增加，以及市场对其人工智能模型长期商业需求的担忧。相比之下，Freedman看好Anthropic成为商业世界全新操作系统的潜力，同时认为短期需求表现强劲。Wang预计该股将跌至59美元，而Freedman给出的合理估值目标为92美元。

items.title: JP Morgan: AI capex to approach $1.4 tln next year, with growth inflection possible in 2028
items.summary: JP Morgan analysts said companies will issue $450 bln of investment-grade bonds in public markets next year to fund AI-related capex, even as the booming sector may eventually see growth peak. AI-focused companies issued $368 bln of investment-grade bonds globally this year, the bank estimated. AI-related capex is expected to nearly double to $1.4 tln in 2027, then stabilize in 2028, with growth slowing sharply as the industry matures. In a quarter in late 2027 or early 2028, market expectations for capex in the following quarter could be broadly flat as sector growth slows, the strategists said. The market reaction is difficult to predict, they added.

items.summary: 【摩根大通：AI资本支出明年逼近1.4万亿美元 2028年或迎增长拐点】金十数据11月26日讯，摩根大通分析师表示，尽管蓬勃发展的人工智能行业未来可能面临增长见顶的局面，但企业明年仍将通过公开市场发行4500亿美元投资级债券，为人工智能相关资本支出提供资金。据该行估算，今年专注于人工智能业务的企业全球投资级债券发行规模为3680亿美元。小摩策略师在报告中写道，2027年人工智能相关资本支出将接近翻倍，达到1.4万亿美元，随后一年趋于稳定。策略师预计，随着行业逐渐进入稳定发展阶段，2028年资本支出增速将大幅放缓。策略师写道：“由于整个行业的增长速度放缓，2027年末或2028年初的某个季度，市场对下一季度资本支出的预期可能基本持平。市场对此会作出积极还是消极的反应，目前还很难判断。”

items.title: White House accuses South Korea of discriminating against U.S. tech firms; Coupang in focus of dispute
items.summary: The White House accused South Korea of breaking a commitment to Trump to treat U.S. tech firms fairly, citing a roughly $688 mln in fines against e-commerce giant Coupang, including a $224 mln provisional fine announced this month against its food-delivery business. The Trump administration opposes what it calls discrimination against U.S. companies by South Korea's Lee and wants Seoul to honor its commitment, including on Coupang. South Korea's embassy in Washington said the country is complying with its agreement with the Trump administration and remains committed to a fair, nondiscriminatory business environment. The State Department said it is actively assessing policy options in response to the alleged discriminatory treatment.

items.summary: 【白宫指责韩国歧视美国科技企业 Coupang成美韩争端焦点】金十数据11月26日讯，据福克斯新闻报道，白宫指责韩国违背了此前向特朗普作出的承诺，未能公平对待美国科技企业。白宫表示，韩国已对美国电商巨头Coupang处以约6.88亿美元罚款，其中包括本月宣布对其食物外卖业务处以的2.24亿美元临时罚款。一名白宫官员表示，特朗普政府反对韩国总统李在明涉嫌歧视美国企业的行为，并希望韩国信守公平对待美国科技企业的承诺，其中包括Coupang。韩国驻美使馆官员表示韩国一直遵守与特朗普政府达成的协议，并致力于营造公平、无歧视的商业环境。Coupang被称为“韩国的亚马逊”，是韩国最大的电子商务公司。该公司以“火箭配送”网络闻名，能够在次日甚至当天将大多数订单送达消费者手中。美国国务院表示，正在积极评估一系列政策选项，以回应其所称的歧视性待遇。

items.summary: 【万斯力挺黄仁勋：没有受到调查 也不需要赦免】金十数据11月26日讯，据CNN报道，美国副总统万斯表示，联邦政府官员曾告知他，重新出任英伟达(NVDA.O)首席执行官的黄仁勋并未受到调查。万斯此番表态淡化了外界对黄仁勋可能构成国家安全风险的担忧。万斯表示：“我们得到的消息是，他没有受到任何调查。我们得到的保证是，他并未受到任何重大调查。针对他的指控来自匿名报道，而非实际证据。”万斯成为最新一位公开为黄仁勋辩护、否认黄仁勋及其公司涉嫌任何不当行为的特朗普政府官员。周二，当美国司法部长布兰奇被问及黄仁勋是否受到过调查时，他反问道：“因为什么事？”当被问及黄仁勋是否需要获得赦免时，与特朗普一样，万斯同样表示：“我认为他根本不需要赦免。”万斯表示，恢复黄仁勋职务的决定最终由英伟达董事会作出，但他没有详细说明自己据称在此事中发挥的作用。

items.title: Report: Kushner urges Netanyahu to honor commitment to Gaza peace plan
items.summary: Trump adviser Jared Kushner urged Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a Tuesday call to honor commitments made to Trump and advance the Gaza peace plan, Axios reported, citing three people familiar with the matter. The White House and Trump-led Board of Peace are frustrated by the lack of progress and believe Netanyahu is prioritizing his political future over Gaza. The call was positive, and Netanyahu reiterated his willingness to move forward, but Israel has taken no concrete action. items.title: Fed Beige Book: U.S. economy grows modestly; consumer spending broadly flat
items.summary: Eight of the 12 Federal Reserve districts reported slight to moderate growth, while activity was little changed in four, the Fed's Beige Book showed. Consumer spending was broadly flat as households grew more price-sensitive and cut nonessential purchases; auto sales slowed and housing activity weakened amid affordability pressures. Employment edged up, with most firms holding staffing steady and hiring mainly to replace departing workers. Wage and benefit growth was modest but faster than in the previous report. Prices rose modestly as energy, transport, healthcare, insurance and tariff-related costs pushed up business expenses, though competition and consumer price sensitivity limited companies' ability to pass them on. Most districts expected slight to moderate growth to continue.

items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to 1 mln satellites to build space data centers
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission approved SpaceX’s plan to deploy up to 1 mln satellites for an orbital data-center network to power complex AI computing, the first such project approved in the United States. SpaceX says the centers would run on solar power and use radiative cooling in space, reducing reliance on terrestrial cooling systems and water. Under an application filed in January, the satellites would orbit 500-2,000 km above Earth and communicate via laser links. Astronomers and industry groups warn the deployment could worsen orbital congestion, raise collision risks and disrupt observations; the American Astronomical Society and others urged the FCC to reject the application. Blue Origin has also applied to deploy space data centers and is awaiting regulatory approval.

items.title: 【SpaceX获美国批准部署最多100万颗卫星 用于建设太空数据中心】金十数据11月26日讯，美国联邦通信委员会批准SpaceX(SPCX.O)发射最多100万
items.summary: 【SpaceX获美国批准部署最多100万颗卫星 用于建设太空数据中心】金十数据11月26日讯，美国联邦通信委员会批准SpaceX(SPCX.O)发射最多100万颗卫星，用于建设轨道数据中心网络，为复杂人工智能计算提供算力。这是美国首次批准轨道数据中心项目。SpaceX表示，太空数据中心可利用太阳能供电，并通过太空中的辐射散热降低对地面冷却系统和水资源的依赖。根据公司1月提交的申请，卫星计划部署在距地面500至2000公里的轨道，并通过激光链路相互通信。不过，该计划引发天文学家及航天业界担忧，认为大规模部署可能加剧轨道拥堵、卫星碰撞风险，并影响天文观测。美国天文学会等机构曾要求FCC否决申请。与此同时，杰夫·贝索斯旗下蓝色起源也已申请部署自己的太空数据中心，仍在等待监管审批。

items.summary: 【“大空头”伯里平仓纳指看跌期权 称当前几乎全面做多】金十数据11月26日讯，因科技股近期大幅下跌，曾因2008年做空美国房地产市场而闻名的投资者迈克尔·伯里表示，其投资组合目前多头仓位已超过空头，且暂时几乎全面做多。他透露，已平仓纳斯达克100指数看跌期权，目前仅持有Palantir(PLTR.N)和MetLife的看跌期权，并持有约25%的现金，计划逐步投入市场。伯里还持有英伟达(NVDA.O)看涨期权，但表示计划等待市场情绪转乐观、股价接近200美元时再度做空英伟达。他认为，目前市场波动率上升，股票看跌期权价格昂贵，直接卖空股票是表达看空观点的主要方式，但风险收益并不对称。其主要持仓包括MercadoLibre、Temple&Webster和京东等公司。

items.title: Iran accuses Israel of using false claims to draw U.S. into war
items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused Israel of spreading false claims that Iran produces and stores chemical weapons at pharmaceutical plants. He said Israel, which has not joined treaties banning nuclear, chemical and biological weapons, was accusing Iran despite its membership in the Non-Proliferation Treaty and Chemical Weapons Convention. Araghchi said Israel had twice drawn the United States into wars against Iran in the past year and that the latest claims aimed to pull Washington into another conflict serving Israeli interests.

items.title: 金十快讯
Kuo: Forecasting AI chip shipments solely from power capacity and chip TDP is too simplistic
items.summary: TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo said AI chip shipments, including GPUs and TPUs, depend on multiple factors. Estimating shipments solely from data center power capacity and chips’ maximum thermal design power (TDP) is too simplistic and does not reflect real-world operations. Chips do not run constantly at maximum power, while newer chips can generate more tokens on the same power supply, potentially boosting demand. In many workloads, running more chips at lower utilization may generate more tokens than running fewer chips at high or full utilization.

items.title: 【郭明錤：仅凭供电能力和芯片功耗预测AI芯片出货量过于简单】金十数据11月26日讯，天风国际证券分析师郭明錤表示，AI芯片（GPU、TPU）出货量受到多种因素影
items.summary: 【郭明錤：仅凭供电能力和芯片功耗预测AI芯片出货量过于简单】金十数据11月26日讯，天风国际证券分析师郭明錤表示，AI芯片（GPU、TPU）出货量受到多种因素影响，仅根据数据中心供电能力和芯片最大功耗（TDP）推算出货量，过于简单，也不符合实际运行情况。他指出，芯片不会始终以最大功耗运行；新一代芯片在相同供电条件下能够生成更多词元，因此可能带动新芯片需求；此外，在不少应用场景中，多颗芯片以较低负载同时运行，可能比少数芯片以高负载甚至满负荷运行产生更多词元。
